W.note: A 232px mint pill at rest that opens to a 296px card with a full six-checkpoint timeline, a plain next-step line, carrier, tracking number and actions, animated with grid-row and width transitions and a clear rotated chevron.

X.note: It rests open at about 300 by 460px, so it is not compact at rest, and it collapses with no body animation; the package rows are non-focusable divs so the event expansion cannot be reached by keyboard, and Next update re-renders the list and drops focus.

Y.note: A small pill that opens smoothly into a dense card with a four-stage stepper, scan list, a shopper action line, labeled buttons, inert hidden body, Escape to collapse, a live region and a reduce-motion toggle, with tiny 10.5px stepper labels as the main weakness.

Z.note: It rests expanded at about 330 by 470px with a multi-package list, collapses instantly with display none and no transition, and has a tiny glyph chevron and no explicit next-step guidance, though its row buttons carry aria-expanded and toasts announce via a live region.
